name: AiChat
short: LLM conversational AI with MCP tool calling
description: LLM-powered conversational AI that responds when mentioned and can call tools on configured MCP servers via function calling. Supports configurable system prompts with context injection.
install_msg: AiChat installed! Use `[p]aichat set apikey` in DMs to configure your OpenAI key, then `[p]aichat mcp add` to connect MCP servers.
end_user_data_statement: This cog sends user messages to OpenAI for response generation. No message history is stored persistently.
